themes.name: Default
themes.description: Warm paper white with near-black ink and a quiet forest-green accent — the familiar DSH layout, warmed up.

themes.name: Mono
themes.description: Strict grayscale in the Vercel/shadcn tradition: black on white, white on black, zero hue in the neutrals.

themes.name: Claude
themes.description: Anthropic's warm cream and clay: bone-white surfaces, warm brown ink and a soft terracotta accent.

themes.name: Claude+
themes.description: Claude turned up: deeper parchment background, darker espresso text and a burnt-sienna accent with more punch.

themes.name: Vermillion
themes.description: Cinnabar seal-ink red on warm paper, with a soot-dark night mode — East-Asian stationery energy.

themes.name: Amber Mono
themes.description: Near-monochrome warm gray with one amber accent — a paper-and-lamp-light minimal look.

themes.name: MX Brutalist
themes.description: Pure white, pure black, hard 1px ink borders and a saturated electric-blue accent — zero softness, high impact.

themes.name: Tiesen
themes.description: Quiet, cool and desaturated: blue-teal ink on a pale mist page, calm enough for long reading sessions.

themes.name: Vescrow
themes.description: Deep indigo night: violet-tinted near-black, a navy primary and a faint lilac stage — dark-first and moody.

fonts.name: System
fonts.description: Native system UI fonts on every platform — zero load cost and the most familiar reading rhythm.
fonts.latin: system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
fonts.cjk: 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Microsoft YaHei UI', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Source Han Sans SC', sans-serif

fonts.name: Humanist (Inter)
fonts.description: Neutral humanist sans with a tall x-height; pairs Inter with Source Han Sans / Noto Sans SC for even CJK-Latin texture.
fonts.latin: 'Inter', 'Inter Variable', 'Segoe UI Variable Display', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
fonts.cjk: 'Source Han Sans SC', 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

fonts.name: Literary Serif
fonts.description: A book-like serif pairing: Source Serif / Georgia for Latin and Source Han Serif / Noto Serif SC (思源宋体) for Chinese.
fonts.latin: 'Source Serif 4', 'Source Serif Pro', 'Iowan Old Style', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif
fonts.cjk: 'Noto Serif SC', 'Source Han Serif SC', 'Songti SC', 'STSong', 'SimSun', serif

fonts.name: Soft Rounded
fonts.description: Rounded terminals and open apertures for a friendly, app-like feel; falls back to PingFang/Noto Sans SC for Chinese.
fonts.latin: ui-rounded, 'SF Pro Rounded', 'Hiragino Maru Gothic ProN', 'M PLUS Rounded 1c', 'Nunito', 'Quicksand', system-ui, sans-serif
fonts.cjk: 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Noto Sans SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', sans-serif

fonts.name: Monospace
fonts.description: Coding-flavoured UI: JetBrains Mono / SF Mono / Cascadia Code paired with Sarasa Mono SC so Chinese glyphs also align to the grid.
fonts.latin: 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', 'Cascadia Code', 'Fira Code', ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace
fonts.cjk: 'Sarasa Mono SC', 'Sarasa Term SC', 'Noto Sans Mono CJK SC', 'Noto Sans SC', 'PingFang SC', monospace

fonts.name: Literary Kai
fonts.description: A calligraphic display pairing for a personal, editorial mood: Palatino for Latin and LXGW WenKai / KaiTi for Chinese.
fonts.latin: 'Palatino Linotype', 'Iowan Old Style', 'Book Antiqua', Palatino, Georgia, serif
